<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****[[Islamabad Memorandum]]
*****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iran foreign ministry]] [[Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran|spokesperson]] [[Esmail Baghaei]] tells Iranian state media that [[President of Iran|president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] and [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] remotely signed the deal to end the war, extend the [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] by 60-days, and [[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis|reopen]] the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. Trump reportedly signed the agreement while at the [[52nd G7 summit|G7 summit]] during a dinner with [[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]. [https://www.axios.com/2026/06/17/iran-deal-signing-text-release (''Axios'')] [https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/us-iran-memorandum-signed-remotely-by-presidents-without-formal-ceremony/ (''Arab Times Kuwait'')] [https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5929356-trump-signs-iran-agreement/ (''The Hill'')]
*****[[Second presidency of Donald Trump|American officials]] officially release the [[memorandum of understanding]] [[Islamabad Memorandum|agreement]] reached with [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/17/trump-world-will-find-out-pretty-soon-if-iran-mou-signing-will-happen (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/17/middleeast/us-iran-war-mou-text-intl (CNN)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/g7-leaders-demand-ceasefire-lebanon-welcome-iran-deal-2026-06-17/ (Reuters)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 United States naval blockade of Iran]]
*****Ship tracking websites, including [[Kpler]], [[MarineTraffic]], and TankerTrackers, show that three Iranian [[oil tanker|oil tankers]], including two from the [[National Iranian Tanker Company]], have escaped the blockade that was imposed on April 13 by the [[United States]]. Additionally, the Iranian-flagged NITC vessel ''M/T Stream'' have reached the blockade line as it headed towards the [[Gulf of Oman]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2026/06/17/iranian-tankers-exit-us-blockade-zone-ahead-of-peace-talks (AFP via Al Arabiya)] [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2026/06/3-iranian-tankers-48m-barrels-oil-pass-us-blockade-what-know (Al-Monitor)]
***[[Operation Epic Fury]]
****[[Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office|U.S. artificial intelligence chief]] Cameron Stanley says that the [[Grok (chatbot)|Grok]] [[chatbot]] was used to launch 2,000 missiles and munitions at Iran during the operation. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/5928204-pentagon-musk-grok-chatbot-iran-strikes/ (''The Hill'')] [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/us-used-musks-grok-deploy-2000-munitions-during-iran-war (''Middle East Eye'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza peace plan]]
****The [[Gaza Health Ministry]] says that over 1,000 [[Palestinians]] have been killed in [[Gaza Strip]] since the [[ceasefire]] was announced [[Gaza peace plan|last year]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-gaza-death-toll-casualties-07ecc0f22a1fb8332466ffc87f928cf4 (AP)]
****[[Hamas]] reports progress in the second phase of [[ceasefire]] talks. [https://shafaq.com/en/Middle-East/Hamas-reports-progress-in-talks-on-Gaza-ceasefire-second-phase (Shafaq)]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] says that they have killed two [[Hamas]] militants who allegedly took part in the [[October 7 attacks]] on [[Israel]] over the weekend in a [[airstrike]] in the central [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-two-hamas-terrorists-who-took-part-in-oct-7-attack-killed-in-central-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Tropical Storm Arthur (2026)|Tropical Storm Arthur]] forms, becoming the first [[tropical cyclone]] of the season after creating significant rainfall across [[Mexico]] and [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/16/weather/tropical-storm-arthur-louisiana-texas-gulf.html (''The New York Times'')]
*Eleven people are killed and 19 others injured after a bus lost control and crashed into a house in [[Huanuco Region]], [[Peru]]. [https://english.news.cn/20260618/3dc9a13418c44f019db1d51c4b03c826/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Ebola epidemic]]
**[[52nd G7 summit]]
***The [[European Union]] and [[G7]] nations at the summit in [[Évian-les-Bains]], [[France]], pledge funding for the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] amidst the [[Ebola]] [[epidemic]] in the country, including in [[Ituri Province]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-g7-pledge-support-amid-drc-ebola-outbreak/a-77588901 (DW)]
*[[Sudanese cholera epidemic (2024–present)|Sudanese cholera epidemic]]
**The TASIS-aligned Peace Government officially declares a [[cholera]] outbreak in the [[Kordofan]] region, with laboratory tests in [[South Sudan]] confirming the disease, after weeks of [[Diarrhea#Definition|acute watery diarrhoea cases]] in [[West Kordofan]]. [https://thesudantimes.com/sudan/tasis-health-ministry-declares-cholera-outbreak-in-kordofan/ (''The Sudan Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2027–2028 United States redistricting]]
**In the U.S., the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]]-led [[Georgia General Assembly]] rejects [[Governor of Georgia|governor]] [[Brian Kemp]]'s attempt to [[Redistricting in Georgia (U.S. state)|redistrict]] [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]]'s [[Georgia's congressional districts|congressional districts]] for the [[2028 United States House of Representatives elections]] in [[2028 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia|the state]] after [[List of speakers of the Georgia House of Representatives|state House speaker]] [[Jon G. Burns]] announced that he will not hold a vote to do so. [https://www.mdjonline.com/state/georgia-republican-legislative-leaders-reject-governors-call-for-2028-redistricting/article_e3e28c0d-6c35-5469-88da-bf6fe08302da.html (''Marietta Daily Journal'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/17/us/politics/georgia-republicans-redistricting.html?smid=tw-nytimes&smtyp=cur (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Immigration to Europe]]
**The [[European Parliament]] passes a law that aims to accelerate the [[deportation]] of [[illegal immigrant]]s. It allows the construction of "return hubs": deportation centers outside of the EU. Other provisions of the law regarding illegal immigrants include allowing the searching of their residences, increasing their maximum prison time, and the imposition of stricter entry bans. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2026/06/17/eu-parliament-approves-strictest-ever-migration-law (Euronews)]
*[[June 2026 President of the Senate of the Philippines election]]
**The [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[Senate of the Philippines|Senate]] elects [[Sherwin Gatchalian]] as [[President of the Senate of the Philippines|Senate president]], formally removing [[Alan Peter Cayetano]] and ending [[May 2026 President of the Senate of the Philippines election#June 2026 leadership crisis|a leadership dispute]] that began on June 3. Gatchalian receives the support of all 13 senators present during a special session. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2248388/senate-row-ends-gatchalian-takes-helm-cayetano-yields (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippine-senate-removes-duterte-ally-head-elects-new-leader-ahead-vp-2026-06-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Afghanistan]]'s [[Taliban]] government imposes a ban on [[Communications in Afghanistan|smartphone use]] by [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] employees, with exemptions requiring approval from [[Supreme Leader of Afghanistan|supreme leader]] [[Hibatullah Akhundzada]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/heartbreaking-afghan-government-staff-abandon-smartphones-following-taliban-order/ (AFP via CTV News)]
*The [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[Royal Palace, Oslo|palace]] says that [[Mette-Marit, Crown Princess of Norway|Crown Princess Mette-Marit]] underwent a [[lung transplantation|lung transplant]] surgery at the [[Oslo University Hospital]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/norways-crown-princess-undergoes-successful-lung-transplant-palace-says-2026-06-17/ (Reuters)]
 
'''Sports'''
*[[2026 FIFA World Cup]]
**[[DR Congo at the FIFA World Cup]]
***In [[association football]], [[Yoane Wissa]] scores the [[DR Congo national football team|DR Congo]]'s first goal at a [[FIFA World Cup]] during a 1–1 draw against [[Portugal national football team|Portugal]] in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K#Portugal vs DR Congo|their opening match]]. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/06/17/ronaldo-fails-shine-dr-congo-earn-historic-world-cup-point/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')]
**[[Uzbekistan at the FIFA World Cup]]
***[[Abbosbek Fayzullaev]] scores [[Uzbekistan national football team|Uzbekistan]]'s first goal at a FIFA World Cup during a 3–1 loss against [[Colombia national football team|Colombia]] in [[2026 FIFA World Cup Group K#Uzbekistan vs Colombia|their opening match]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/soccer/diaz-shines-colombia-beat-uzbekistan-3-1-2026-06-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudan]]'s [[Sudan women's national under-17 football team|women's national under-17 football team]] makes its first appearance on international stage in [[Morocco]] in an effort to [[Football at the 2028 Summer Olympics – Women's qualification|qualify]] for the upcoming [[2028 Summer Olympics]] in [[Los Angeles]] amidst the [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|ongoing]] [[civil war]] in the country that [[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|erupted]] three years ago. [https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/sudan-women-soccer-civil-war-la-olympics-b2997632.html (''The Independent'')]
